text.body: bhāvopaniṣat || atha bhāvopaniṣata|| oṃ bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devāḥ | bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ | sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāsastanūbhiḥ | vyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ | svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ | svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo'riṣṭanemiḥ | svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu | oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || ātmānamakhaṇdamaṇdalākāramavṛtya sakalabrahmāndamandalaṃ svaprakāśaṃ dhyāyet | śrīguruḥ sarvakāraṇabhūtā śakttiḥ || 1|| tena navarandhrarūpo dehaḥ || 2|| navacakrarūpaṃ śrīcakram || 3|| vārāhī pitṛrūpā kurukullā balidevatā mātā || 4|| puruṣā|rthāḥ sāgarāḥ || 5|| deho navaratnadvīpaḥ || 6|| tvagādi sapttadhāturomasaṃyukttaḥ || 7|| saṃkalpāḥ kalpataravastejaḥ kalpakodyānam || 8|| rasanayā bhāvyamānā madhurāmlatikttakaṭukaṣāyalavaṇarasāḥ ṣaḍṛtavaḥ || 9|| jñānamardhyam jñeyam havirjñātā hotā jñātṛjñānajñeyānāmabhedabhavanam śrīcakrapūjanam || 10|| niyatiḥ śrṛṅgārādayo rasā aṇimādayaḥ || 11|| kāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsa|ryapuṇyapāpamayā brāhmyādyayaṣaṭaśakttayaḥ || 12|| ādharanavakam mudrāśakttayaḥ || 13|| pṛthivyaptejovāivākāśāśrotratvakcakṣurjihvaghrāṇa vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthāni manovikārāḥ kāmākarṣiṇyādi ṣodaśa śakttayaḥ || 14|| vacanādānāgamanavisargānandahānopādānopekṣākhya bhuddhayo'naṅgakusumādyaṣṭau || 15|| alambusā kuhurviśvodarā vāraṇā hastijihvā yaśovatī payasvinī gāndhārī pūṣā śaṅkhinī sarasvatīḍā piṅgalā suṣumnā ceti caturdaśa nāḍyaḥ sarvasaṃkṣhobhiṇyadi caturdaśaśakttayaḥ || 16|| prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānanāgakū|rmakṛkaradevadattadhanaṃjayā daśavāyavaḥ sarvasiddhipradādibahirdaśāradevatāḥ || 17|| etadvāyusaṃsargakopādhibhedhena recakaḥ pācakaḥ śoṣako dāhakaḥ plāvaka iti prāṇamukhyavena paṃcadhā jaṭharāgnirbhavati|| 18|| kṣāraka uddhārakaḥ kṣobhako jṛṃbhako mohaka iti nāgaprādhānyena paṃcabidhāste manuṣyāṇāṃ dehagā bhakṣhyabhojyaśoṣyalehyapeyātmakapañcavidhamannaṃ pācayanti|| 19|| etā daśavahnikalāḥ sarvajñādyā antardaśāradevatāḥ || 20|| śītoṣṇāsukhaduḥkhecchāḥ sattvaṃ rajastamo vaśinyādiśaktthayoaṣtau || 21|| śabdādi tanmāttrāḥ paṃcapuṣpabāṇāḥ || 22|| mana ikṣhudhanuḥ || 23|| rāgaḥ pāśaḥ || 24|| dveṣo'ṅkuśaḥ || 25|| avyaktta mahadahaṃkārāḥ kāmekṣvarī vajreśvarī bhagamālinyo'ntasttrikoṇagā devatāḥ || 26|| nirupādhikasaṃvideva kāmeśvara || 27|| sadānandapūrṇa svātmeva paradevatā lalitā || 28|| lauhityametasya sarvasya vimarśa || 29|| ananyacittatvena ca siddhiḥ || 30|| bhāvanāyāḥ kriyā upacaraḥ || 31|| ahaṃ tvamasti nāsti kartavyamakartavyamupāsitavyamiti vikalpānāmātmani vilāpanam homaḥ || 32|| bhavanāviṣayāṇāmabhedabhavanā tarpaṇam || 33|| paṃcadaśatithirūpeṇa kālasya pariṇāmāvalokanam || 34|| evamaṃ muhūrtattritayaṃ muhūrtadvitayaṃ muhūrtamāttraṃ vā bhāvanāparo jīvanmuktto bhavati sa eva śivayogīti gadyate|| 35|| ādimatenāntaścakrabhāvanāḥ pratipāditāḥ || 36|| ya evaṃ veda so'tharvaśiro'dhīte || 37|| ityupaniṣat || oṃ bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devāḥ | bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ| sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāsastanūbhiḥ | vyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ | svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ | svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ| svasti nastārkṣyo'riṣṭanemiḥ | svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu| oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || || iti bhāvopaniṣat ||
